checks.name: duplicate flow_id in flow CSV
checks.message: flow CSV should normally have one row per flow_id.

checks.name: packet flow_id missing in flow CSV
checks.message: Every packet flow_id should normally have a matching row in the flow CSV.

checks.name: flow CSV flow_id missing in packet CSV
checks.message: Every flow CSV row should normally have at least one packet in packet CSV.

checks.name: packet count mismatch
checks.message: packet CSV group size should equal total_fwd_packets + total_backward_packets.

checks.name: direction count mismatch
checks.message: Packet direction counts should match total_fwd_packets and total_backward_packets.

checks.name: invalid packet direction values
checks.message: Packet direction should be 0 or 1 for all packets used in Stage1.

checks.name: multi-packet flow_duration == 0
checks.message: Single-packet duration=0 is fine; multi-packet duration=0 is suspicious.

checks.name: flow duration disagrees with packet timestamps
checks.message: If packet timestamp range is positive but flow_duration is zero, aggregation timing may be wrong.

checks.name: flows with total_backward_packets == 0
checks.message: A high one-way-flow ratio may be normal for some PCAPs, but is suspicious for mostly bidirectional traffic.

checks.name: flow length stats zero but packet length positive
checks.message: This often means flow length stats are payload-based; consider enhanced IP-length flow features.

checks.name: flow label != max(packet_label)
checks.message: Flow label should equal max packet_label if your plugin defines flow label as any alert in the flow.
